headline_title: April revenue NZ$80,599.98 across 451 orders, up 1.77% on March
trend_title: Revenue steady after the February dip, up 1.77% month on month
trend_qty_title: Units reach 2,563, up 3.89% on March and above the January level
structure_intro_title: Premium lines account for NZ$36,917.92, 45.8% of store revenue
category_mix_title: Supplement leads at 34.7% of revenue; souvenir takes 17.7% of units on 12.4% of value
premium_mix_title: Supplement, honey and souvenir each hold roughly a quarter of premium revenue
top_products_title: Six of the top 10 SKUs are premium, led by Solwave Liver Support Complex
brand_title: Solwave at 7.8% of store revenue heads the supplement brands
milk_brand_title: Clearfield 23.8% and Ambervale 22.1% split the milk powder category
milk_brand_note: Clearfield, Ambervale and Two Rivers sit within two points of each other, so no single brand anchors the category; Westbrook at 6.4% is the smallest of the six listed.
pickup_title: Pickup premium rises to NZ$2,238.73 as regular pickup falls to NZ$4,996.31
pickup_comment: Premium pickup value and units (45) are both the highest of the four months, while regular pickup dropped from NZ$10,231.29 in March. Keep a premium facing at the collection counter so waiting customers see the range.
functional_title: Liver support NZ$4,082.87 and fish oil NZ$4,865.41 lead functional lines in April
functional_note: Liver support rose from NZ$862.89 in March to NZ$4,082.87, and joint care from 47 to 98 units; eye care and magnesium both fell back. Group the liver support and fish oil facings together on the supplement bay while demand holds.
channel_title: Export 1,300 units against local 1,265, a 50.7/49.3 split
channel_comment: Export units rose 5.69% and local 2.02% on March, with export back above the January volume of 1,265 after the February fall that is typically affected by Chinese New Year freight suspension.
concentration_title: Top three deciles of SKUs carry 62.3% of revenue
operations_title: 244 visits, 96 mini-programme leads at 63.0% completion, tour group of 30 on 12-14 Apr
campaign_title: Autumn health check promo and new honey range launch
campaign_bullets:
Supplement shoppers: autumn health check promotion
Honey range: new range launch
